mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_log (pay_no, request_id, order_id, order_no, user_id, amount, channel, status) VALUES (#{payNo}, #{requestId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{channel}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, pay_no, request_id, order_id, order_no, user_id, amount, channel, status, external_txn_id, fail_reason, paid_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pay_log WHERE request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, pay_no, request_id, order_id, order_no, user_id, amount, channel, status, external_txn_id, fail_reason, paid_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pay_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
